palette.notes: Measured 11-20 colours per sheet (run 11, slide-roll 12, four-legged walk 16, wall slide 18, walk 19, jump 20), UI included. Ramps shift both ways (+24 to +48 deg, -10 to -46 deg); dithering about 1%.

lighting: Pale blue-white mannequins lit flat from above with one darker shade, so the pose reads, not the rendering; the four-legged walk adds an orange leg-colour code to separate near and far legs.
silhouette: Generic mannequin figures so the pose carries everything; strong lean in the run and slide, open legs on contact frames, a tucked ball for the roll.

motion.timing: Walk 12 frames at 100 ms (1.2 s cycle), run 32 frames at 80 ms, jump 24 at 80 ms, slide-roll 16 at 80 ms, wall slide 18 at 80 ms, four-legged walk 16 at 100 ms. Even holds everywhere; locomotion runs at 12.5 drawings/s, walks at 10.

texture: Plain flat sprites on solid panels; dust puffs at slide and land, and small sparks on wall-slide contact are the only texture.
camera: Static; cycles play in place in a strip of key poses while one copy travels across a panel, showing the cycle and the move side by side.

acting.enters: The jump figure starts from a crouch, rises and lands; the walker crosses the panel from one side to the other and wraps.
acting.acts: Jump is split into anticipation crouch, launch, rise, invert at the peak, fall and contact squash; the roll tucks into a ball and unrolls into a recover pose.
acting.exits: Moving copies exit by walking or running out of the panel and wrap back in from the opposite edge.
acting.depth: One plane; the jump panel shows the figure small in a wide space next to a close strip of the key poses.

techniques: walk in 6 keys per step (12 frames): contact, down, passing, up
run with one foot off the ground and a forward lean, body high on the passing pose
jump in phases: crouch anticipation, stretch on launch, tuck at peak, stretch on fall, squash on contact
slide as a low held pose with dust behind, then a roll into a ball and a recover pose
wall slide: back to the wall, one hand dragging, sparks at the contact point
four-legged walk: diagonal leg pairs move together, near and far legs coloured apart
feel: pose-first mannequins + clear contact frames + crouch before every jump = movement that reads in 12 frames
for_fred: Make Fred travel in and out of frame with a real move instead of sliding the sprite: a 2-frame crouch, a stretched launch, a squash on landing, and a swim cycle with clear key poses at 80 ms. For an exit he can jump or swim off the edge and return from the opposite edge, like the wrapping walker.
